info.title: World Engine GPT Actions API
info.description: Persistent authoritative world/game-state API for the World Engine GPT, including the World Engine Turn Protocol (WETP-1.0), capability routing, a universal entity/relationship graph, knowledge provenance, a bounded context compiler, deterministic tabletop-RPG rules, WORLD/SCENE spatial layers, off-screen simulation, automatic image cues, persistent visual continuity, and a shadow-safe narrative director/dialogue/prose-quality compiler. ChatGPT normalizes intent and renders prose; this service owns facts, routing, context selection, mutations, narrative contracts, and audit records.

post.description: Create a campaign if absent and return its authoritative clock, weather and revision.
Create/update a character. Intended for campaign setup or explicit authoritative edits.
Create/update persistent location description, tags and structured state.
Apply persistent healing or damage from any source and ledger the reason.
Move a character/NPC to a new persistent location and ledger movement.
Resolve a bounded 5e-style d20 check. This does not mutate game state by itself.
Resolve a baseline 5e-style attack, apply persistent HP damage, and ledger the outcome.
Define or execute one deterministic generalized rules-kernel operation.
Add/remove a persistent condition on a character or NPC and log the change.
Mutate persistent character resources/inventory and log the change.
Adjust persistent directed trust/fear/respect/affection between two entities.
Create/update a persistent quest, objectives and status.
Start/restart persistent combat and roll/store initiative.
Advance to the next persistent initiative turn, incrementing round when required.
End persistent combat and record the reason.
Advance authoritative world time and run configured off-screen simulation by default.

Route one normalized player turn through the World Engine Turn Protocol (WETP-1.0).

ChatGPT supplies bounded intent objects; the backend selects capabilities,
compiles relevant context, executes deterministic providers, records
idempotency/revisions, and returns an auditable result packet.
Persist authoritative appearance/gear descriptors and request a canonical identity reference when due.
Build a prompt/package for ChatGPT native image generation at scene starts, battle starts, new locations, or event choices.
Record that an image cue has already been served so repeated scenes do not spam duplicate images.
Validate and durably publish exact accepted narration without mutating world state.

simulate.title: Simulate
simulate.description: Execute configured off-screen world simulation while time advances.

season.title: Season
season.description: Optional season override for resource growth; defaults to campaign setting or summer.

damage_type.title: Damage Type
damage_type.description: Structured damage type for resistance, immunity, vulnerability, and ledger output.

narrative_hint.title: Narrative Hint
narrative_hint.description: Optional presentation-only inputs such as scene_function, speaker_id, speech_act, facts_to_reveal, information_to_withhold, subtext, and mechanically_supported_player_effects. These cannot overwrite authoritative state.

intent_id.title: Intent Id
intent_id.description: Stable identifier within this turn; defaults to intent_1, intent_2, etc.

type.title: Type
type.description: Friendly intent alias such as move, check, attack, interact, relation, fact, or advance_time.

capability.title: Capability
capability.description: Explicit capability ID; takes precedence over type when supplied.

additional_instructions.title: Additional Instructions
additional_instructions.default: Show the current scene clearly, with readable composition, setting-authentic environmental detail, and strong environmental storytelling.

negative_instructions.title: Negative Instructions
negative_instructions.default: UI overlays, text blocks, watermarks, or anachronistic elements not established by the World Bible.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Persistent visual descriptors used only as scene-image continuity inputs; this does not trigger a portrait.

state.title: State
state.description: Persistent visual continuity descriptors for a location, scene, or combat.
